g.text: One dot represents one team's score, where one team is one pair of defenders A and B trained corresponding to one seed. The black line is the mean of the teams that have a value; a team without one is not drawn. The numbers under an arm are its teams' denominators in seed order. Lines are the

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: rule baselines. The attacked pair is the pair of servers the intrusion landed in. A team that interrupts the attacked pair's server in under 1 percent of intrusion episodes has a red ring.
